name: DCA Carthay Circle Lounge — Alfresco Dining: Kids' Teriyaki Salmon/Chicken & Rice or Artisanal Cheese Board
brandOrRestaurant: Carthay Circle Lounge — Alfresco Dining (Buena Vista Street · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Carthay Circle Lounge (easier walk-up waitlist than the main dining room!) has a Kids' Orecchiette Pasta or Grilled Salmon/Chicken Breast with steamed white rice that any guest can order.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Join the walk-up list in the Disneyland App and order the Grilled Salmon or Chicken Breast with steamed white rice (or plain butter/Parmesan pasta), or graze on the aged hard cheeses and crackers from the Artisanal Cheese Board.
watchOuts: Skip whole nuts, olives, and spicy harissa/chili appetizers on the lounge menu
